rows.label: Revenue
rows.source: Wema Bank 2025 Annual Report, consolidated statement of profit or loss, printed page 122 (_ngx_pdf/WEMABANK.pdf), Group column, NGN thousands scaled to naira. Group total of interest income, net fee and commission income, net trading income, other income and net gain on FVTPL securities. FY2023 is the Group gross earnings already carried for that year (226,914,538 thousand), matching the published FY2023 figure.

rows.label: Operating Expenses
rows.derivedFrom: Personnel expenses + Depreciation and amortisation + Other operating expenses, Group column, page 122.
rows.source: Wema Bank 2025 Annual Report, consolidated statement of profit or loss, printed page 122 (_ngx_pdf/WEMABANK.pdf page index 120), Group columns, thousands of naira scaled by 1000: FY2025 personnel expenses 70,184,778 plus depreciation and amortisation 12,479,855 plus other operating expenses 116,062,499 equals 198,727,132; FY2024 45,475,369 plus 8,740,108 plus 77,482,216 equals 131,697,693. Printed in parentheses, so stored negative. Ties: operating income 420,614,268 less 198,727,132 equals the printed profit before taxation 221,887,136, and 234,214,863 less 131,697,693 equals 102,517,170. H1 2026 left blank: the stored EBIT for that period already equals profit before tax, so an operating expense row there would not tie.
